Scholarship Guide.pdf: Scholarship applications must be submitted by September 30. Incomplete applications will be returned.
Scholarship recipients receive an award of 750 dollars.
Observatory Handbook.pdf: The observatory opens its doors to visitors at 7:30 p.m. on Fridays.
The maximum number of visitors on an observatory tour is 18.
Garden Guide.pdf: The public garden is closed every Tuesday for routine maintenance.
Tomato seedlings should be watered twice a week.
